The planes are so much dirtier than airliners from other countries. Inflight meals are disgusting. I don't ever purchase meals.
reviews.author: Maki

reviews.title: Pathetic airline
reviews.text: Ever since UA adopted the woke philosophy, their business acumen has gone down the toilet. This includes upgrading through their plus points system to basic services, including their Polaris lounge and on board services (not) provided by crew members. I am cutting all business dealings with United Airlines,
reviews.author: owen

reviews.title: United Airlines is a great airline for everybody!👍🏻👍🏻👍
reviews.text: On my return flight home from Fort Myers on 12/4/23(this past Monday, two days ago), there were seat back entertainment screens (TVS) and I was entertained the whole flight along with wi-fi. The only thing that happened as we were deplaning in Cleveland was my mom left her wallet on the plane (we were on N16234) in between seats 27A and B. But other then that, United is always and will always be my favorite airline! Keep up the great work, United!👍
reviews.author: Sage Kopp

reviews.title: Mixed bag
reviews.text: UA fails in service. The seat is very comfortable tho no help from setting up for sleep by the flight attendants. Was dressed for a business meeting the next day only to learn pyjamas are no longer on flights less than 14 hrs ( so a 12 hr overnight flight doesnt count?) so had to sleep in my business attire . Service from flight attendants was poor. Meal came on one plate ( so by the time you ate your starters, main course was cold) and all over in 1 hr after takeoff. Despite the attendants offering ice cream for desert it was a pannecotte and not ice cream. When i questioned this, was told thats NZ catering- ok but why call it ice cream. I woke up 1 hr before landing. Had my do not disturb sign on so expected to miss breakfast but no one came around to say good morning or would you like a cup of coffee when i woke 1 hr before landing. Whilst a big improvement on their old business class, theres a long way to go in on board service to justify the cost. Only competition is Air NZ but their business seats are a joke.
reviews.author: pegasusSydney

reviews.title: Ceo
reviews.text: Business class fare RT for this route was about $8000. For this huge premium over coach you get: Use of quite crowded pre flight lounges with pedestrian food and drink, a lie flat cubicle that is so tight as to be dangerous IMO, no pre- boarding, no free wifi, very ordinary food and service not much different than coach, a decent wine selection. For me, never again. I’ll take Jet Blue Mint class which is much less expensive, offers boarding preference, free wifi, larger cubicles, friendly crew!
reviews.author: Visgilio

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: The only great product that United provides is the amazing Polaris airport lounge and fine dining. Sadly this high quality product does not extend to the on board flight experience!!! Very narrow seat, tight footwell with little room to move, economy style food and sub standard in flight service for a ticket costing over $14000!! Much needs to be improved they get my money again. One cabin steward kept calling me “Buddy” and no spoon or saucer for a cup of tea.
reviews.author: Frank T

reviews.title: Business Class flight made our vacation end memorable
reviews.text: We got business class flights from Toronto to POS through Houston that was cheaper than economy tickets for the same route on other airlines. This allowed us 2 checked in bags at 70lbs each and hassle free check in at the counter in Toronto Pearson. I think there was a strike action as the normal check in line was very long so this was already welcome. The flight was on time and in flight experience was very professional. Our lounge experience at Houston was good fun. The Houston to POS leg of the flight was exciting and it was my son and wife's first experience in business class. The best? The good in flight service, the wine was shared without hesitation and the quality of the food was excellent.

reviews.title: Love United Polaris

reviews.author: Gail K

reviews.title: Customer Disservice
reviews.text: Our first flight was delayed two hours (for a myriad of reasons, all different from the last) and we were not notified by the United employee when we checked in at the Asheville regional airport. This two hour delay would have resulted in missing our connection and the international flight from LAX to MEL, but we found a flight out of CLT to LAX with absolutely no help from the AVL United employee (he gave us a phone number to call and sent us on our way, saying there was nothing he could do for us, even though he had just finished helping the couple in front of us with the same itinerary delays). Made it to LAX in time to catch the initial flight to MEL after booking the flight ourselves. Made it to our seats only to wind up sitting on the tarmac for two hours due to a flat tire caused by “running over a washer” (read: negligence) on the runway. By the time the tire was fixed, the crew was over their authorized hours, and the flight was canceled. We were told that we would be rebooked to our initial destination (Melbourne), but we were rebooked to Sydney, which is about 539 miles off our initial destination. In order to solve this, we were directed to another United customer service desk where we stood in line for an hour with 50+ United customers dealing with similar “rebooking” issues. It was 2:00 am by the time we were able to talk to a United customer service employee, and good god I wish we hadn’t. For two hours we stood at that counter and did not get a straight answer to our questions, ie.) He told us he booked tickets for our party of 4 on the same alternative route to Melbourne, but when we checked our itineraries, the flights were still destined for Sydney or, to our surprise, Brisbane. When we asked for the tickets to be printed, we were told there were only 2, even though all 4 of us at the counter repeatedly had to remind him that there were 4 of us. On top of this, a customer that had been previously helped cut his way in line twice to commandeer Pax’s attention even though we requested he wait so we could have a chance to get our stuff sorted out as well. It was 4:30 am at this time, we were given a motel voucher by Pax, and told we had rooms booked for the night, but when we called the motel to verify, we were informed we had no bookings and there were no rooms available. Cots were eventually provided for customers that didn’t have any options other than spending the night in the airport, only to be collected about an hour and a half later. The United customer service line has been long and slow moving all day already, which indicates that these issues are still persisting, and United is not prioritizing the one thing it needs to: its customers.
reviews.author: Jess R

reviews.title: Absolutely DO NOT RECOMMEND to anyone seeing their military partner.
reviews.text: I can understand TSA having rules and that military do not get a free pass through everything, but the snarkiness, rudeness and lack of regard for mine or my boyfriend's expierence was appalling. Not only did they mock him for asking if he could come with me to the gate, they rolled their eyes and scoffed while we hugged and I cried. They continued to treat my belongings awful and be extremely cold and unwelcoming. It was so noticeable several people came to me to see if I was okay who were also upset by the situation. Lovely to see this is how United treats its military and their loved ones. I understand having rules, but I will never forget this awful expierence and will never fly United again.
reviews.author: Ren C

reviews.title: United Airlines is a Joke
reviews.text: Introduction: In an era where travelers seek seamless journeys and reliable airlines, United Airlines falls short of expectations with its dismal performance at Cancun Airport. As a passenger on flight UA 1049, I experienced an arduous ordeal that lasted over 24 hours, marred by lack of staff and poor communication. The airline's failure to provide timely service and assistance left me frustrated and compelled to seek alternative arrangements using personal funds. This review sheds light on the grievances faced and emphasizes the need for a refund along with additional compensation for the inconveniences endured. Delayed Departure and Lack of Staff: One of the fundamental responsibilities of an airline is to ensure timely departures and arrivals. Unfortunately, United Airlines failed to meet this basic requirement during my experience. Flight UA 1049 was delayed for an extended period, leaving passengers stranded in the Cancun airport for over 24 hours. This delay was attributed to a purported shortage of staff, which is an unacceptable excuse considering the significance of Cancun as a popular tourist destination. Passengers were left in a state of confusion and frustration as the airline struggled to address the situation promptly. Financial Burden and Inadequate Assistance: United Airlines' inability to manage the situation adequately placed an undue financial burden on its passengers. Due to the excessive delay, I had to arrange housing and taxi services at my own expense, further exacerbating the inconvenience caused. The airline's lack of assistance in providing alternative accommodations or transport options was disheartening, as it demonstrated a clear disregard for the well-being and comfort of its passengers. United Airlines should have taken proactive measures to alleviate the financial strain and inconvenience experienced by passengers during this extended delay. Poor Communication and Customer Service: Effective communication is key during such situations, as it helps passengers understand the issues at hand and fosters a sense of trust. Regrettably, United Airlines faltered in this aspect as well. The lack of clear and timely updates regarding the status of the flight left passengers in a state of uncertainty. The airline's customer service representatives seemed ill-equipped to handle the situation and failed to provide satisfactory explanations or resolutions. Prompt and transparent communication is essential in maintaining a positive customer experience, an area where United Airlines clearly needs improvement. Refund and Compensation: Given the magnitude of the inconveniences faced, it is only fair that United Airlines provide a full refund for the disrupted flight. Additionally, the airline should offer additional compensation to affected passengers to acknowledge the physical and emotional strain they endured. Such compensation would not only help rectify the financial burdens incurred but also act as a gesture of goodwill, rebuilding trust among passengers who were let down by the airline's poor performance. Conclusion: United Airlines' handling of flight UA 1049 at Cancun Airport was nothing short of a disappointing experience. From the extended delay to the lack of staff and poor communication, the airline's failure to meet basic customer service standards was evident. Passengers were left to fend for themselves, forced to bear additional expenses and endure unnecessary stress. It is imperative that United Airlines takes immediate action to rectify this situation by offering a full refund and additional compensation to affected passengers. Only by addressing these issues and improving their service can United Airlines regain the trust and loyalty of its customers.
reviews.author: Jake M

reviews.title: Breaks their promises and makes customers pay for employee mistakes
reviews.text: Our flight was bumped and United offered us the option of leaving in the morning. I spoke to a supervisor to ask about a hotel. I was told that we could go to the airport to pick up a hotel voucher OR, since that was inconvenient since we were not at the airport yet, we could pay for any hotel out of pocket and as long as we mailed in the receipt, I would be reimbursed for the full amount of the hotel stay (cash or flight credit, my choice). I asked all of the right questions: Any restrictions? Nope. Any specific hotel we had to use? Nope. Dollar amount limit? Nope. Was this already approved? Yes. We stayed at a Marriott (close by and convenient). I promptly submitted the required documentation to United. After several attempts to obtain a status, I was informed by United that while the person that I spoke to was a supervisor and they confirmed what I was told, that United would NOT be reimbursing me any money because THEIR EMPLOYEE gave out inaccurate information. What happened to companies honoring representations made by their employees? I relied on the representation made by a United Airlines supervisor and did everything that I was told to get my hotel stay reimbursed. (A hotel stay that would have not been necessary if they could get their flights to leave on time). If they cannot train their employees on their own policies, that should be on them when a customer makes plans and spends money in reliance on what they were told. Instead, they make their customers pay for United's mistake. While they did send me a very nominal flight credit, this is not how a responsible company should act. I asked for contact information of someone higher up that I could speak to about this, so that I could bring this to their attention. United ignored me. On another note, most of the flights that I have flown on United lately do not leave on time. On another flight, we had to make an unscheduled landing due to a maintenance issue, no apologies or concessions. Never again will I book a flight on United, as I am convinced that they have the worst customer service of any airline, which already is a very low bar.

reviews.title: Disappointing flight on United Airlines Polaris Business
reviews.text: The United Polaris Business class lounge for international flights on United is amazing. Great food and service. Sadly the same level of food and service is not available on board the flights!! Long delays in being offered a welcome drink, i.e champagne and often served in a plastic cup. Cabin crew never call you by your name like on other Star Alliance carriers, I.e. Singapore Airlines or Swiss or even Virgin. Mediocre food quality, flight crew not very proactive. Seat comfort ok, but has a very narrow footwell. Bathrooms tiny and the paper towel bin was often full and unhygienic to dispose in bin pushing down with hands!! Crew may need to be more aware to empty bins. A foot pedal would be hands free!! Overall I don’t think their Polaris business class product is worth paying over $A 14000 for a return airfare to the US Correction to earlier remark re flight crew. I meant to say Cabin crew!!
reviews.author: Frank T

reviews.title: I would not recommend this airline company
reviews.text: I embarked on a lengthy journey from Australia to South America with United Airlines for the first time, and I must say that the service was abysmal in every aspect. Firstly, the economy class had minimal food options, even on extended flights. During one of the meals, we were served a miniature bread roll with a chicken paste that would not satisfy even a child's appetite. The headphones provided were extremely uncomfortable, and the flights were overcrowded, leading to passengers being forced to check their handbags with essential belongings. I witnessed people crying during this process. Additionally, the unethical baggage weighing procedure at US airports was inexplicable. I had already weighed my suitcase in Australia, and I was only in transit, but I was made to weigh it again in San Francisco and asked to pay two hundred dollars because my suitcase was a kilo over the allowed limit. This occurred on both legs of my journey, and I had to engage in a lengthy discussion with a United employee, explaining how it sounded like extortion. Lastly, I noticed a significant difference in service quality between the USA-Brazil and USA-Australia routes. The food offered on the South American stretch was of poor quality and quantity, which made me question why the airline made a distinction between continents. Overall, my experience was terrible, and I would not fly with United again unless it was absolutely necessary. I hope the company improves its services.

reviews.title: Nice upgraded flight from DCA to ORD
reviews.text: You are going to read a wide range of reviews regarding United Airlines flying from DCA Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. I have been flying to and from DCA for more than the past couple of decades or more. I will summarize my overall impression of United Airlines and my most recent UA2224 flight from DCA to ORD. I upgraded our flight to 1st class using my points, which was confirmed weeks prior to our flights. As a United Club member we both had access to their United Club on the second floor. Our flight boarded from gate B12, which was very close to the United Club. Since we were in Group 1 we boarded our flight prior to the latter groups. Our flight departed and arrived on-time and was smooth flying. We both enjoyed two complimentary cocktails and a bag of savory pretzels in 1st class. I remember years ago when you would enjoy a little bit more than a bag of savory pretzels in 1st class. It could include a salad, breakfast or a sandwich. I recommend United should offer more than a bag of savory pretzels in 1st class. Our flight attendant was very accommodating regarding our needs. When we arrived at ORD our checked luggage arrived in a timely manner. More to come regarding our return flight from ORD to DCA.

The staff on the plane where so nice it was a pleasure to fly with them . Oh by the way they give you a lovely packet of chocolate truffles at some point to which are beautiful. reviews.title: United Airlines will not give you good customer service
reviews.text: I flew back from Seattle to United Airlines to Tampa Florida. While in the air to make my connecting flight in Houston United Airlines cancelled my connecting flight! Once I landed they were unable to get me another flight home and actually had the audacity to say the flight was cancelled due to weather. The reality is they had a pilot strike. No other airlines had any problem with the weather that day. To make matters worse United Airlines did not care that they had no other flight for me until 2 days later! I ended up renting a car and DRIVING back from Houston to Tampa! United Airlines refused to reimburse me the extra $1100 it cost me to get a hotel, rent a car and buy gas to return home-a job they contracted to do for me when they sold me an airline ticket! They gave me a $100.00 voucher and felt that was sufficient! What would that look like to a young person or a person who did not have the means to rent a car and pay those extra expenses? HORRIBLE customer service-its obvious all they care about is the money. I will never fly this airline again which is sad because historically they were always the airline that treated their customers with respect and value.

A flight attendant was very rude to me when ordering a drink. Be aware that purchases of food/drink can only be made by having previously downloaded the United app and entering your credit card information. On our return flight, our checked baggage was returned extremely filthy, like the bags had been used to wipe down the cargo area. United's app is clear that unless you report it at the airport they are not responsible (we were tired from international travel and wanted to go home).

reviews.title: Air hostess were late
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed by an hour as the air hostesses were late to work, we had a short connecting time to our other destination which was only an hour stop over to begin with. Thankfully the pilot called ahead and asked SFO to hold the flight and they did but we only had 10 mins to get to the gate. Once on the flight they were rude to the other staff and the passengers. Wouldn't rush to fly with them anytime soon.
reviews.author: rachelhamilton27

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: The polaris lounge was nice. The food was okay. The bar was great with high end alcohol. It was nice to not have kids and coach people. Often coach people try to get drunk before boarding a long haul flight. i have been flying business or first class to Paris once a year for over three decades. I have not flown United in years. with all the strikes I decided it was safer to fly it rather than Air France. I probably will return to Air France next year. The food on the plane was awful. The bed was much better than Air France which is the trade off.
reviews.author: Brellie

reviews.title: Delayed/cancelled flight
reviews.text: Flight delayed at least 5 times with as many gate changes because they said another flight delayed our plane then after bouncing us from gate to gate and waiting 5 hours they cancelled the flight now due to a radar problem. I used my plus points and was upgraded but on the rebook i lost my upgrade and was not reimbursed my plus points. These airlines lie and treat passengers like sheep, they have one of the oldest fleets, their mileage program stinks, theres too many 1kers so the only way to be upgraded is to use miles or plus points or cash. Their food has sucked forever. Mostly vegan garbage. They are no better than american airlines.
reviews.author: Charles M

reviews.title: Inadequate staff Flt UA-57 Newark to Paris
reviews.text: United should change service class from Premium Plus to Premium minus. My flight was very under staffed and they tried to do their best, but service was terible. During entire flight the drink cart came by only twice and that was just before meals. Alcoholic drinks were limited to one. After evening meal was served, it took over one hour to get food tray removed. Forced to sit looking at left over food. I tried to use call button, but no response. Overworked staff seemed to take out their frustration on the passengers.
reviews.author: Dwight R

reviews.title: Don't fly United!
reviews.text: Constant, avoidable mistakes were made that turned what should have been 5 hours of travel turned into 22 hours of travel. I will never fly United EVER again. I have never been so disappointed with an airline or one single travel experience in 20 years of flying. It was absolutely unacceptable. Also, their staff is consistently very rude and unhelpful from state to state. They need to train them or hire people with a stronger customer service, de-escalation, and problem solving background. Horrific experience. Never again.
reviews.author: cflood2019

reviews.title: United flight delay. No reason. No compensation. NO ACCOUNTABILITY!!!
reviews.text: Our connecting flight UA1595 on 29th April from Belize City to Newark arrived at 9.12pm, 10 minutes earlier but passengers were not allowed to exit the aircraft for approximately 50 minutes because there were no gates available. It was already a tight connection at approx 1 hour 40 mins. There were a total of 14 people on this flight connecting to UA146 which departs at 11pm from Newark to London Heathrow. When we were finally able to exit, our connecting flight was already boarding but our bags had not appeared on the designated baggage claim carousel. Upon check in we were denied boarding and our flight was rebooked as UA110, depart 6pm on 30th April, the next day. We were put up in Double Tree Somerset Hotel, 45 minutes away in the middle of nowhere. We checked in at the hotel at approximately 1am on 30th April. The meal vouchers supplied to us could not be fully utilized due to insufficient value and the hotel only served food from 6am to 12pm. We later found out that our original scheduled flight UA146 only departed at 2.23am on 30th April. Why were we denied boarding in the first place?? We were told to pay first and be reimbursed later for taxi to the hotel and from hotel to the airport the next day, both trips costing USD155. We finally arrived in London, Heathrow on 1st May approximately 6.57am, a day later. Transport had been arranged to pick us up on our original arrival date and time but due to this delay there was no one to pick us up and we had to take a taxi from the airport to get home costing £350!!! I have emailed United Airlines with a request to full compensation for all the inconveniences they had put us through and refund of all out of pocket expenses but they only offered compensation in mileage points and vouchers. We will NEVER EVER fly United again so what good are the stupid points and vouchers??? United Airlines can screw up your flights as and when with no reasons given and no accountability and are by far the WORST airlines we have ever had the misfortune to fly with. DO NOT FLY UNITED AIRLINES!!!
reviews.author: Saff S
